name: timeout-keeps-wait-row
guard: a timeout consumes the wait row

name: hit-returns-a-fixed-outcome
guard: an await that hits returns the outcome the event carries

name: emit-overwrites
guard: the completion event is first-write-wins
find:
IF doneEvent = None
  THEN /\ doneEvent' = o

name: emit-leaves-wait-row
guard: the emit that wakes a waiter consumes its wait row
find: THEN parent' = "woken" /\ parked' = o /\ wait' = FALSE
replace: THEN parent' = "woken" /\ parked' = o /\ wait' = TRUE

name: emit-parks-another-outcome
guard: the woken parent is handed the outcome the event carries
find: THEN parent' = "woken" /\ parked' = o /\ wait' = FALSE
replace: THEN parent' = "woken" /\ parked' = (CHOOSE x \in Outcomes : x # o) /\ wait' = FALSE

name: miss-ignores-existing-event
guard: a wait registers only while the event is absent

name: cancel-keeps-wait-row
guard: cancelling the parent deletes its wait row

name: miss-ignores-rule
guard: a refused await registers no wait

name: hit-ignores-rule
guard: a refused await returns no outcome

name: revive-clears-event
guard: retry-task leaves the completion event alone
find:
/\ child' = "live" /\ retries' = retries + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<firstOutcome, doneEvent, parent, wait, parked, seen>>
replace:
/\ child' = "live" /\ retries' = retries + 1 /\ doneEvent' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<firstOutcome, parent, wait, parked, seen>>

name: emit-wakes-a-timed-out-parent
guard: an emit wakes only a parent with a wait row

name: claim-woken-returns-nothing
guard: the woken parent's await returns the parked outcome

name: refused-registers-a-wait
guard: a refusal registers nothing
find:
/\ parent' = "refused"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<child, firstOutcome, doneEvent, wait, parked, seen, retries>>
replace:
/\ parent' = "refused" /\ wait' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<child, firstOutcome, doneEvent, parked, seen, retries>>

name: first-outcome-ghost-rewritten
guard: the first outcome is recorded once
find: firstOutcome' = IF firstOutcome = None THEN o ELSE firstOutcome

name: timeout-takes-a-woken-parent
guard: a timeout takes only a parent that is still waiting

name: emit-wakes-a-cancelled-parent
guard: an emit wakes only a parent with a wait row, and a cancelled parent has none

name: refuse-ignores-rule
guard: an await the rule allows is never refused

name: terminal-skips-the-emit
guard: a terminal batch writes the completion event

name: forged-emit-ignores-the-rule
guard: only a terminal batch writes the completion event

name: emit-takes-the-wait-and-wakes-nobody
guard: the emit that consumes a wait wakes its parent
find: THEN parent' = "woken" /\ parked' = o /\ wait' = FALSE

name: cancel-writes-an-unknown-state
guard: every state a batch writes is one the model knows

name: miss-registers-on-an-ended-child
guard: an await never registers a wait on a child that has ended

name: miss-registers-on-an-unknown-child
guard: an await never registers a wait on a task that does not exist

name: older-build-ends-a-child-under-a-wait
guard: the deploy rule: an older build ends no child while a wait is registered

name: materialize-leaves-the-event-unwritten
guard: the await that finds an unrecorded ending writes the event
find:
/\ doneEvent' = child
  /\ firstOutcome' = IF firstOutcome = None THEN child
replace:
/\ doneEvent' = doneEvent
  /\ firstOutcome' = IF firstOutcome = None THEN child

name: materialize-writes-a-fixed-outcome
guard: the event an await writes is the child's own outcome
find:
/\ doneEvent' = child
  /\ firstOutcome' = IF firstOutcome = None THEN child
replace:
/\ doneEvent' = "completed"
  /\ firstOutcome' = IF firstOutcome = None THEN child

name: materialize-ignores-the-rule
guard: an await across queues writes nothing

name: materialize-overwrites-an-event
guard: an await writes the event only when none exists
find:
/\ child \in Outcomes /\ doneEvent = None
  /\ doneEvent' = child

name: unknown-child-refusal-reaches-a-real-child
guard: only an await of no task at all is refused as unknown

name: spawn-by-a-parent-that-is-not-running
guard: only a running parent spawns a child
